reason:
Related concepts, entity keys/names/attributes and physical roles remain separately qualified in assertions. Coverage means inspected hypothesis presence, not accepted semantic equivalence or external match rate.

Phase 2 UNRESOLVED: Separate calendar date, local wall time, UTC instant, duration, observation period and validity bounds. Timezone, calendar and source event role are prerequisites for conversion. Employees 9999-01-01 is an open-ended validity sentinel; shift time lacks a date. A midnight string alone does not establish a UTC instant. Date-only native/source semantics can reuse core date; timestamp truncation needs an explicit query transformation. Definition gap: the candidate combines source roles or lacks a sufficiently bounded reusable definition and binding domain. Retain the candidate; do not infer absence from literal query results. Examined 6 physical field-role hypotheses for this group; their individual dispositions govern implementation.
